column1: # AryaCAD panel footprints — what a device occupies on a mounting plate.
# One row per device class. `match` is `CLASS:<class>` (case-insensitive, matched
# against the component class the symbol library gives the device), or `DEFAULT`
# for anything not listed. Width and height are millimetres of mounting plate the
# device needs; `mount` is where it belongs:
#   rail  — on a 35 mm DIN rail on the mounting plate (breakers, contactors, PLC)
#   door  — on the enclosure door, needs a round cut-out (buttons, lamps)
#   plate — screwed straight onto the plate (drives, sensors, earth)
# A project can keep its own copy: ELECPANEL reads library/panel/footprints.tsv
# first, then <project>/footprints.tsv if it exists, and later rows win.
